dict.string: Gaithano Speak listens to your microphone while you hold the dictation key, so it can turn your speech into text.
Gaithano Speak briefly checks whether audio is actually playing so it only pauses real playback while you dictate — it measures the output level and never records or stores any audio.
Agent Mode controls apps on your behalf — clicking, typing, and reading what is on screen — only for the actions you approve when you hold the agent key.
Gaithano Speak uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe your dictation.
Speech recognition powered by NVIDIA Parakeet (CC-BY-4.0) via FluidAudio.
